name: gitsail-vscode
description: Git context in the editor, backed entirely by the gitsail CLI — never a second, editor-side implementation of Git.

gitsail.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `gitsail` CLI executable. Only honored in a **trusted** workspace. Leave empty to discover `gitsail` on `PATH` — see this extension's README ("Binary distribution") for why v0.4 does not bundle a binary.

gitsail.blame.enabled.description: Show inline blame decorations in the editor (US-072). Turn off to disable them entirely.

enumDescriptions: Only decorate the line the cursor is currently on.
gitsail.blame.mode.description: Which lines get an inline blame decoration (US-072 criterion 2).

gitsail.blame.delayMs.description: Milliseconds of cursor inactivity before an inline blame decoration (re)appears (US-072 criterion 2).

gitsail.blame.format.markdownDescription: Template for inline blame text. Placeholders: `${author}`, `${authorEmail}`, `${date}`, `${hash}`, `${shortHash}`, `${message}` (US-072 criterion 1).

gitsail.desktop.path.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the GitSail Desktop executable, used by "Open in GitSail Desktop" (US-077). Leave empty to disable the handoff — GitSail then offers to copy the commit hash instead.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GitSail repository context and CLI queries are unavailable until the workspace is trusted.
